summary: Public citation of Sourcey, the open data registry of startup credits, published on a real external site (an admitted host outside GitHub and outside sourcey.com itself). The registry's canonical page https://sourcey.com/startup-credits and its machine-readable release https://sourcey.com/startup-credits.json were verified live over HTTPS on 2026-11-06; the release (release_id sha256:f6182296…) lists 586 companies and 648 offers, and the citation page links to both URLs near the top of the page.

observations.detail: Sourcey publishes its open startup-credits registry at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits; the page is a real external site reachable over HTTPS (HTTP 200) and describes the open registry.
The machine-readable JSON release at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits.json is valid JSON with release_id sha256:f6182296…, listing 586 companies and 648 offers.

A public page on an admitted external host carries a visible anchor <a href="https://sourcey.com/startup-credits"> near the top of the page, plus a link to the .json machine-readable release; the page was created on 2026-11-06 for the purpose of publishing this verifiable citation.

evidence_items.description: Sourcey publishes its open startup-credits registry at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits, a real external site reachable over HTTPS.
evidence_items.observed: Canonical human-facing page of the registry; HTTP 200 with registry content.

evidence_items.description: Sourcey publishes a machine-readable JSON release of the registry at https://sourcey.com/startup-credits.json.
evidence_items.observed: Valid JSON release with release_id sha256:f6182296…, listing 586 companies and 648 offers.

evidence_items.description: A public page on an admitted host carries a visible anchor linking to the Sourcey registry.
evidence_items.observed: Citation page contains <a href="https://sourcey.com/startup-credits"> near the top of the page, plus a link to the .json release.

evidence_items.description: The citation page discloses its purpose and date of creation.
evidence_items.observed: Disclosure section dated 2026-11-06 states the page exists solely to publish a verifiable public citation.
